# Asked latches, with a model in the seat

Seat `deepseek-chat`, design `bach`, 6 repeats per arm. `TwoLatches`' commitment world with the
`blockedBy` route removed: nothing in the graph uses the withholding convention, so the fatal tool
stays on offer and the only way through is to call `recall` and then act on what comes back. The
answer arrives as that action's observation, which the loop writes into the seat's history.

Arm A may ask and has no memory. Arm C has the memory, is handed notes every tick, and may ask. Arm E
has the memory and may ask but is told nothing unless it loses the route. C against E is the first
comparison in this line that can say whether injected notes add anything to what an agent can fetch
for itself.

| E ask only | 6 | 6 | 0 | 6 | 0 | 2.0 | 0.0 | 0/6 | 2.7 |
